title: Cauliflower-Cheese Pasta
directions: Cook shells in boiling water, cooking oil & 1st. amt. salt until tender but firm - about 13-16 min.
Meanwhile melt butter in pan, mix in flour, second amt. of salt & pepper. Stir in milk until it boils & thickens. Stir in cheese.
Cook cauliflower in salted water until tender crisp. Drain. Add to sauce. Drain shells & add. Mix tog. Put into 2 qt greased casserole.
Mix bread crumbs & melted butter. Spread on top. Bake @ 350° for about 25 min. until browned & hot.
